controles.affirmation: REGLEMENTAIRE : rappel classe I FDA sur les "corrections volontaires... initiees en avril 2025 pour un risque de sous-perfusion" ; arret temporaire de distribution US/Canada depuis juillet 2025
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "Beginning in April 2025, we initiated a voluntary correction for the Novum LVP due to the potential for under-infusion when the pump is in 'standby mode' for an extended period of time. Beginning in July 2025, we initiated voluntary corrections for the Novum LVP due to the potential for under-infusion when the pump is directed to deliver a bolus infusion... The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) classified these voluntary corrections as Class I recalls."
controles.correction_proposee: Le classement en classe I porte sur les corrections engagees a partir de juillet 2025 ("these voluntary corrections" renvoie a la phrase precedente), pas sur celle d'avril 2025. Ecrire : "corrections volontaires engagees a partir de juillet 2025". Le reste (arret de distribution depuis juillet 2025, calendrier de reprise incertain) est verbatim conforme.

controles.affirmation: JUDICIAIRE : CID du DOJ recue en decembre 2025 sur la production des contenants IV souples et le False Claims Act ; Baxter cooperant ; ce n'est pas une enquete ouverte formellement
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "In December 2025, we received a CID from the DOJ requesting documents and information related to production of Baxter's IV flexible containers and compliance with the False Claims Act. We are cooperating fully with the DOJ in responding to the CID."
controles.correction_proposee: Formulation prudente et exacte, y compris la distinction demande d'information / enquete.

controles.affirmation: JUDICIAIRE : "la premiere [CID], initiee en 2022, vise l'ancienne filiale Hillrom"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "In October 2022, the Department of Justice (DOJ) issued a Civil Investigative Demand (CID) addressed to Hillrom... In October 2024, the DOJ issued a subpoena (the 2024 Subpoena)... to Hillrom."
controles.correction_proposee: Date et objet exacts, mais Hillrom n'est pas une "ancienne filiale" : c'est une filiale toujours detenue (segment Healthcare Systems & Technologies). Ecrire "la filiale Hillrom, acquise en 2021". A noter aussi que l'ATT omet le subpoena d'octobre 2024, plus lourd que la CID.

controles.affirmation: Depreciation de goodwill de 485 M$ en 2025 sur Front Line Care apres 425 M$ en 2024 ; valeur comptable residuelle 1,51 Md$ au 30 juin 2026
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "we recorded goodwill impairment charges of $485 million and $425 million, respectively related to our Front Line Care reporting unit" ; 10-Q T2 2026 : "As of June 30, 2026, the carrying amount of goodwill for our Front Line Care reporting unit was $1.51 billion."

controles.affirmation: Ouragan Helene : preuve donnee entre guillemets "...customers have adopted fluid conservation practices with permanent clinical modifications reducing demand", et argument selon lequel la demande future est reduite "structurellement"
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025 : "In response to Hurricane Helene and the related supply disruption, certain customers have enacted fluid conservation practices embedded with clinical practice changes which have resulted in, and are currently expected to continue to result in, reduced demand in our intravenous (IV) solutions business". Le texte entre guillemets de l'ATT n'existe dans aucun document source : c'est une retro-traduction de la synthese francaise v2-pipeline ("modifications cliniques permanentes").
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer la fausse citation par le verbatim du 10-K et retirer "permanent/structurellement" : la societe ecrit "currently expected to continue to result in reduced demand", pas une reduction permanente.

controles.affirmation: Special items amputant le resultat net du T2 2026 de 155 M$, soit 0,30$ par action diluee ; 182 M$ au T2 2025 ; BPA GAAP publie 0,24$
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "our results included special items that adversely impacted net income (loss) attributable to Baxter stockholders by $155 million, or $0.30 per diluted share" ; "Net income (loss) from continuing operations for the three months ended June 30, 2025 included special items that adversely impacted net income (loss) by $182 million, or $0.35 per diluted share" ; "$126 million, or $0.24 per diluted share"
controles.correction_proposee: Reserve de forme : les 155 M$ et les 182 M$ ne sont pas sur la meme base (net attribuable pour 2026, activites poursuivies pour 2025, ou l'equivalent net attribuable est 185 M$/0,36$). Ecart faible, sans effet sur la conclusion.
